scope: Original synthetic data only; no personal conversations, queries, embeddings or private evaluation results.
feature: Explicit bounded candidate-session selection before constrained source reading through existing MCP tools.
covered_contracts: One exact UTF-8 excerpt per distinct authorized source/session; long top-ranked text cannot exhaust the entire candidate screen.
Scores are ordering signals, never calibrated confidence; negative cosine remains explicitly unassessed.
Source account/platform/conversation/scope boundaries and Event filters/as_of apply before candidate counts and output.
Cursor pages groups without repetition and binds query, filters, source snapshots, ranking, access, mode, limit and byte budget.
Tiny budgets distinguish budget_exhausted from no_matches and retain vector-availability diagnostics.
Missing query vectors remain explicit lexical fallback without provider requests.
Oversized source/session labels are bounded and visibly marked without inventing exact references.
Selection read_args preserves anchor, filters, as_of and the exact lexical or semantic excerpt offset.
Real stdio MCP exposes bounded choices and reads an explicitly selected synthetic anchor.
limitations: Candidate presence does not prove relevance or select the correct session.
No automatic relevance classifier, confidence threshold or gold-specific ranking change was added.
A candidate cursor does not read text tails or expand graph neighbors.
Per-call UTF-8 byte caps do not cap a full workflow; callers must limit total calls and cumulative output.
No tokenizer tokens, billing, model answer quality, desktop IPC or blind semantic accuracy were measured.
